name: Eel Strike (Combat)
body:
You can strike swiftly and retreat beyond your enemy’s reach.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, swim speed.

Benefit(s): While swimming, if you use the withdraw action you can take a single melee attack as a swift action before you begin your movement.
